what: A person's decisions on the free tide pass's review rows (pipeline/tide_free_pass.py). 'reject' keeps a spot's row out of any import. 'accept' names the value the person checked: the row is written only while the pass still proposes exactly that value. A proposed row with no entry may be imported once reviewed; an uncorroborated one only with an accept. Each spot is named exactly as in pipeline/spots_enriched.json, by name and state, with a note.
